回答 5 利益衝突及與宏業建築之關係

13. 在宏福苑火災發生前，本人對招標過程中存在任何潛在利益衝突、關連人士或不合規事宜全不知情。

問題 6 Please state whether you were aware of any concerns raised by residents in relation to the conduct of the meetings of the OC (including the means by which proxies were solicited and/or collected from residents in respect of the OC meeting on 28 January 2024 and 6 September 2024). In particular:

問題 6.1 Please provide your comments on the allegations by some witnesses that in order to attract residents giving their proxy votes, you and/or your team members assisted residents in applying for the Mandatory Building Inspection Subsidy Scheme (as set out in the Summary of evidence).

回答 6.1 關於授權票及街站活動的指控

15. 本人知悉有居民曾於本人曾參與的街站或接觸中查詢業主大會的運作，但內容僅限於「何時間、在哪裡開」等一般會議資訊。

16. 本人強烈否認關於「協助居民申請資助以吸引授權票」的指控。協助居民填寫市建局「樓宇更新大行動 2.0」等資助計劃、派發申請表及協助填表，乃是本人及本人議員辦事處同事履行區議員職責及日常服務範圍的常規更民服務，當中絕無向居民要求授予授權票作為交換條件。

問題 6.2 Please describe and clarify your role in collecting proxies from the residents of Wang Fuk Court and the steps taken by you and/or your team members to:

6.2.1 obtain the proxies from the residents. Please describe and explain the purpose, the time and place in which the proxies were obtained and stating the date(s) of the AGMs, EGMs and/or other meetings of the owners for which the proxies were sought;

6.2.2 verify the identity of the residents providing the proxies; and;
